clauses.quote: The superintendent may delegate to other school personnel the exercise of any powers and the discharge of any duty assigned to the Superintendent by the Board under these policies.
The delegation of power or duty, however, shall not relieve the superintendent of responsibility for any action taken under such delegation.
clauses.subject_text: The delegation of power or duty
clauses.notes: Operatively restricts the removal of superintendent liability despite delegation.

clauses.quote: When the Superintendent anticipates he/she will be absent from the city for a period of time, the superintendent may designate a system employee to act on his/her behalf during the absence and to perform such duties and make such decisions as may be necessary.
clauses.notes: Contains a conditional subordinate clause; main clause grants designation authority.

clauses.quote: If such designation will last for a period of longer than 5 working days, the board shall be notified by letter in advance.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is superintendent/management.
